prompts.name: Meeting minutes
prompts.text: Convert my actual transcript or notes into concise meeting minutes: purpose, key discussion, confirmed decisions, open questions and action items with owner and due date. Do not invent attendees, agreement, deadlines or commitments. Mark missing owners and dates explicitly. Distinguish proposals from decisions and dissent from consensus. Preserve uncertainty and cite transcript passages when available. Keep sensitive personal details out unless essential.

prompts.name: Execution plan
prompts.text: Turn my goal and constraints into an executable plan. Break work into ordered milestones with dependencies, deliverables, owners when supplied, acceptance checks and risks. Distinguish estimates from commitments. Prefer reversible steps and define checkpoints before high-impact changes. Include fallback options and the smallest next action. Do not claim that any action has already been performed.
